meta.summary: One playthrough is enough: free roam, the side strands and the 100% checklist all stay open after the credits. The order below follows the official descriptions — the five chapter trophies, then the six named missions, then the checklist counts, then the strand finales and the one-off oddities.

sources.name: GTA Snaps — roadmap, difficulty and the three steps

stages.title: Chapter 1 — the opening and the one trophy you can lose
stages.goal: Play Gone Fishing through Discharge Time, and take the balcony meditation before the chapter closes.
stages.why: Two story trophies sit here, Just Like Paradise on the first mission and Paradise Lost as Chapter 2 opens. The only missable trophy in the list is also here: the balcony meditation at Jason's house exists only in Chapter 1.
stages.caution: Say yes when Lucia offers to meditate. Shirley's two errands also close when Tourist Trap starts; they carry no trophy, but they are gone for good.

stages.title: Chapter 2 — partners, garages and side work
stages.goal: Finish the chapter for Trust and T**s Ass Drug Money, and use the unlocks it hands you.
stages.why: Chapter 2 is short but it switches on the systems the rest of the list depends on: the partner call after Coffee Break, the Moses garage jobs and Randy's deliveries, Bret's hunting strand, and the Vice City Real Estate app.
stages.caution: Start Bret's and Billy's strands here if you want them out of the way; both need a chapter 2 main mission first.

stages.title: Chapter 3 — banks, jewelry and the Key Cloner
stages.goal: Play the biggest chapter for Vice City, Baby! and Break the Bank, and pick up the robbery tools.
stages.why: Credit Check adds the Dye Pack Jammer and bank jobs, Yasmani's jewelry jobs open the stores, and Randy's car theft hands over the Key Cloner. Those three items unlock Dime on the Dollar, Sneakthief, Capital Offense and the vault trophies later.
stages.caution: Blow all three cell towers in Hidden Charges for the full window into the heist.

stages.title: Chapter 4 — the airport, the vaults and the family
stages.goal: Clear the chapter's story trophies, then start That's Where The Money Is for the vault grind.
stages.why: Four trophies land here: Top Of The World, Ma at the chapter's end, plus Family Matters, DWNFALL and Hi-Jacked inside named missions. VCIA Takedown also opens the optional job that makes large bank vaults robbable, which is where Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play come from.
counts: 8 large vaults exist, 5 needed for the trophy
stages.caution: Keep a manual save before the VCIA setup chain; missions cannot be replayed.

stages.title: Chapter 5 — the finale
stages.goal: Play Operation Savage Glory and the last mission.
stages.why: The shortest chapter holds the second gold, You Gotta Know When to Get Off, and Snow Storm. Finishing it does not close anything: the checklist, the strands and every robbery stay open.
stages.caution: Save before the finale if you want to see the other endings.

stages.title: The 100% checklist — where most of the list falls
stages.goal: Open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and work it county by county.
stages.why: A Long Road is the gold, and the checklist is also the natural home of the count trophies: 250 stunts, 42 range golds, 14 drone stations, 100 WAiNK scans, 3 card sets, 100 vehicles, 50 challenges, 9 gangs and the money and property lines. The checklist asks for more than the trophies do in some lines and less in others, so read the counts column before grinding.
counts: 300 of 397 stunts for the checklist, 250 for the trophy
42 of 42 range golds and 42 of 42 drone trials are all-or-nothing
15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles, 70 of 80 challenges
stages.caution: Scan vehicles and study animals from Chapter 1; both lines finish themselves if you start early.

stages.title: Stranger strands and character finales
stages.goal: Finish eight stranger strands, then the six character finales and the fishing and arcade jobs.
stages.why: Strangers & Freaks wants eight completed strands, and the checklist ignores strands entirely, so this is the step the 100% run does not cover. Andy is Lucia's, Tyrone and Bret are Jason's, and Billy, Randy and Kenton sit in between; a strand that never appears usually means the wrong character.
stages.caution: Race Against Yago runs on an hourglass. Start it the moment it appears.

stages.title: The one-off oddities
stages.goal: Mop up the hidden one-offs: the showroom, the airport, the tank, the UFO, the bowling job and the combat tests.
stages.why: These are single events with cryptic official descriptions, so they need a trip each rather than a grind. Most need a story unlock first: the Key Cloner for the showroom, Chapter 3 for payday loans, That's Where The Money Is for the armoured truck, and a partner for the two co-op robberies.
counts: 1 UFO, after 2:00 AM in Kelly County
stages.caution: Do the stealth and escape trophies before the Criminal Profile climbs to Psycho, where police shoot sooner.

stages.title: The platinum
stages.goal: Let Vice Got a Price! fire once the other 54 are on the account.
stages.why: No online, no DLC, no second playthrough: the platinum is a receipt for the other 54, and free roam keeps everything reachable after the credits.
stages.caution: Cheats switch off trophies and saving for the session; keep them out of this save.

missableBrief.headline: One trophy can be lost, and it is lost early
missableBrief.body: Positive Mental Attitude needs a meditation at every spot, and the first spot is Jason's balcony in Chapter 1. It is the only trophy in the list with a deadline. Guides agree on the cutoff and still argue about whether the balcony session is strictly required for the trophy, which is exactly why it should be taken: it costs two minutes and cannot be recovered later.
